name: Entity Reference Link
description: Format Entity Reference fields as links
project_description: Entity Reference Link ships a single field formatter, "Entity Reference Custom Link" (plugin id entity_reference_link), for core entity_reference fields. Instead of linking each referenced entity to its own canonical page, it builds a fully custom link per referenced item: the URL comes either from a named Drupal route (with the referenced entity ID and/or the referencing entity ID injected as route or query parameters) or from a custom href template, and the link text, extra HTML attributes and multi-value list markup are each driven by small inline Twig templates exposing the tokens {{ id }} (referenced entity ID), {{ referencing_id }} (the entity holding the field) and {{ label }} (referenced entity label). It is aimed at cases where an entity reference should point at a view, a form-prepopulation URL, a report page or any other route keyed by the referenced ID, rather than at the entity itself. All configuration lives in the field display settings; the module adds no routes, services, permissions, config schema or dependencies beyond core field.
